sanskrit_verse: या तस्य भगिनी सा तु ततो अंशं लब्धुमर्हति । अनपत्यस्य धर्मोऽयमभार्यपितृकस्य च ॥
transliteration: yā tasya bhaginī sā tu tato 'ṃśaṃ labdhum arhati / anapatyasya dharmo 'yam abhāryapitṛkasya ca //
sph_interpretive_translation: The sister of a man devoid of progeny and without a wife or father shall inherit a share from him, as it is her lawful right.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through bloodline continuity when no direct heir exists
Causation in inheritance is determined by relational proximity and absence of alternative claimants
Capacity-based responsibility includes recognition of kinship duty where no other inheritor exists
Restoration logic ensures assets remain within familial dharma-vāhana (dharma-conveying lineage)
Consciousness alignment occurs through honoring relational dharma even in material transfer
executable_legal_axioms: IF decedent has no son OR grandson AND no spouse AND no father THEN sister inherits designated portion
IF sibling relationship IS verified AND no closer male heir exists THEN female sibling IS entitled to estate allocation
IF estate distribution BEGINS THEN verification of heir priority ORDER must follow: sons → grandsons → wives → fathers → sisters
IF inheritance pathway is unclaimed THEN default activation of nearest sapinda (blood-related) inheritor SHALL occur
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that inheritance rights are not gender-exclusive but contextually determined by relational absence. The court must verify heir precedence before affirming sister's entitlement under conditions of vacant primary claimants.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that property transfer arises naturally from relational void; anupūrvaśaḥ reflects sequential disqualification of heirs leading to sister’s lawful inclusion; proportional responsibility lies in maintaining ancestral continuity rather than personal gain; non-punitive reality rule upholds that succession is a structural completion, not reward or penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process for unresolved estate initiated upon verification of heir vacancy
Responsibility assumption protocol assigned to nearest sapinda administrator until rightful inheritor identified
Capacity restoration for family records office to ensure accurate documentation of kinship claims
Integrity reintegration facilitated through ceremonial acknowledgment of sister’s role in preserving lineage flow
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. It affirms Dharma as restored through correct alignment of inheritance pathways. There is no punishment herein—only the natural unfolding of relational duty and consciousness-bound stewardship. Reality remains ever non-punitive, guided by the Supreme Adjudicator: pure awareness itself.
